raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (txn_ids 904163 onward, ingested 2026-01-18) stores `amount` with a leading '$' (e.g. '$29.57'), while other batches are plain decimals. The cast to DECIMAL(12,2) fails on these values. Stripping '$' and thousands separators before the cast is a deterministic fix that keeps the amount and currency meaning unchanged, and any unexpected format will still fail loudly rather than corrupt data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(regexp_replace(trim(amount), '[$,]', '', 'g') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
